title: Console colours
description:
Colour console output with both the old attribute API and ANSI escape codes.

```
error   -> attribute 0x0C (bright red), ANSI "\x1b[91m"
warning -> 0x0E (yellow), "\x1b[93m"
info    -> 0x07 (grey), "\x1b[0m"
```
hints: Attribute values combine bits: `FOREGROUND_RED | FOREGROUND_INTENSITY` is `0x0C`.
requirements: A table of a few levels with their attribute value and ANSI code.
`paint(text, level)` returns the ANSI-coloured text with a reset at the end.
Note in a comment that virtual terminal processing must be on (`ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_PROCESSING`).
stretch: Print a 16-colour chart of every attribute value.
